name: Default
shortDescription: Federated link aggregator and discussion forum with the Lemmy backend, web UI, pict-rs image hosting and PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with the username admin and the generated LEMMY_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The account is created only on the first start, so changing the variable later has no effect.
Set the final domain before the first deploy. Lemmy writes it into every user, community and post ID, so the instance cannot move to another domain later.
No SMTP server is configured, so email verification and password resets do not work. Add an email block to the lemmy.hjson mount and redeploy if you need them.
